# Current Data Inventory

## Audit contract

- Repository code and external data roots are supplied separately.
- Inputs are read-only and checked by SHA-256 before and after generation.
- Files over 25 MiB use the first and last 1,000 rows for column metrics.
- Artifacts discovered: 1487
- Profiles completed: 1487
- Profile failures: 0

## CLI command contract

```text
python -m tools.data_audit --repo-root <repo-root> --data-root <data-root> --inventory-output <repo-root>/docs/data/current-inventory.md --lineage-output <repo-root>/docs/data/current-column-lineage.csv
```
- Repository root identity: `<repo-root>`
- Data root identity: `<data-root>`

## Discovery scope

- Recursively include `data/**/*.csv` beneath `<data-root>`.
- Include optional top-level `r2_objects.csv` beneath `<data-root>`.
